identity_evidence: Executive Order 2073, signed Wilson November 4, 1914, amending Paragraph 49 of the Panama Canal navigation rules
basis: Amends a Panama Canal operating regulation on radio tolls for ships on Canal business; it concerns only the U.S. operation of the canal and has no object after the canal passed to Panama.
end_or_bound: no later than 1999-12-31 (U.S. operation of the canal ended)
operative_quote: No radio tolls, either coast station or forwarding, will be imposed against ships on radiograms transmitted by ships on Canal business.

identity_evidence: Executive Order 1605, signed Taft September 12, 1912, consolidating the Administrative Districts of Gorgona and Empire; special judge provision in Sec. 4
basis: Reorganizes Canal Zone administrative districts and district courts and provides for special judges; all content is internal to the Zone government and courts.
end_or_bound: no later than 1982-03-31 (Zone courts; Zone government itself ended 1979-10-01)
operative_quote: Sec. 2. The Administrative District of Gorgona is hereby abolished, and the territory heretofore embraced in said District is incorporated into the Administrative District of Empire
notes: Sec. 8 keeps the senior district judge office until 1912-12-31, which is part of the same Zone judicial reorganization. Text carries no order number in the body; number appears in the page header only.

identity_evidence: Executive Order 1532, signed Taft May 21, 1912, amending the order of May 13, 1911 on a distillation tax in the Canal Zone
basis: Amends the Canal Zone distillation tax order, allows another measurement method and ends the right to operate stills in the Zone from 1913 under a Zone misdemeanor penalty; all within Zone law.
end_or_bound: no later than 1979-10-01 (Zone government and laws ended)
operative_quote: On and after January 1, 1913, the right to operate any still within the Canal Zone shall cease and determine

identity_evidence: Executive Order 370, signed Roosevelt November 15, 1905, temporary appointments for service on the Isthmus of Panama for the Isthmian Canal Commission
basis: Lets the Civil Service Commission allow temporary appointment of canal-service employees when no eligible has the needed qualifications; it applies only to Isthmian Canal Commission service. The page header states it was revoked by Executive Order 393 on January 12, 1906.
end_or_bound: no later than 1906-01-12 (revoked by EO 393 per page header); in any event no later than 1999-12-31
operative_quote: the Civil Service Commission may allow a temporary appointment, which may be made permanent on certificate of the Isthmian Canal Commission that such action is required in the interests of good administration.
notes: Text says Isthmus of Panama and Isthmian Canal Commission rather than Canal Zone; I treated it as canal employees' conditions of service. The revocation is stated in the page header, not in the order's own words, so a second reviewer may prefer the 1999-12-31 bound.

identity_evidence: Executive Order 1116 date July 30, 1909 signed Wm. H. Taft; diminution of sentences of convicts in the Canal Zone penitentiary
basis: Sets good-time credit for convicts in the Canal Zone penitentiary, a Zone penal rule that applied only to Zone prisoners and the Zone warden.
end_or_bound: no later than 1982-03-31 (Zone courts and penal administration; Zone government ended 1979-10-01)
operative_quote: every convict who is now or who may hereafter be confined in the Canal Zone penitentiary under sentence for a definite time
notes: No number in the text; matched by date, signer and subject.

basis: The order designates one named person as special judge, which is a one-person appointment and an outlier for this lot; it belongs elsewhere.
operative_quote: September 21, 1922, I designate Judge James W. Blackburn as Special Judge of
notes: Own terms ran until 1928-01-01, but status_no is not supported because of the one-person outlier. OCR noise in the heading.

ceremonial committee, not Zone government or canal operation

operative_quote: The persons named below are hereby appointed members of this committee.
notes: No order number in the text; matched by date, signer and subject.

identity_evidence: Executive Order 1141, signed Taft November 23, 1909, any person who induces workmen of the Canal Zone to break contracts shall be fined or imprisoned
basis: Creates a Zone misdemeanor for recruiting Zone workers away from the Isthmian Canal Commission or Panama Railroad Company; the offense is defined by recruiting on the Canal Zone and the penalty is imposed by the Zone court.
end_or_bound: no later than 1979-10-01 (Zone government and laws ended)
operative_quote: shall be deemed guilty of a misdemeanor and, upon conviction thereof, shall be punished by a fine not exceeding one thousand dollars ($1,000.00)
notes: Mentions the Panama Railroad Company only as an employer of the protected workers, not as a corporate matter.

identity_evidence: Executive Order 3226, signed Wilson February 11, 1920, charges for services of the Quarantine Division of The Panama Canal
basis: Authorizes the Governor of the Panama Canal to set quarantine service charges for vessels at the canal and repeals the 1911 night-inspection ordinance; it applies only to the canal's quarantine operation.
end_or_bound: no later than 1999-12-31 (U.S. operation of the canal ended)
operative_quote: The Governor of The Panama Canal is hereby authorized to establish, from time to time, a schedule of charges to cover services rendered by the Quarantine Division of The Panama Canal

identity_evidence: Executive Order 1468, signed Taft February 5, 1912, inexpensive method for administration of estates of deceased and insane employees

creates a settlement procedure with continuing claims by heirs (Sec. 10)

identity_evidence: Executive Order 1812, signed Wilson August 9, 1913, appointing Richard Lee Metcalfe to the Isthmian Canal Commission
basis: The order appoints one named person to the Isthmian Canal Commission, which is spent on issue and is an outlier for this lot.
operative_quote: Richard Lee Metcalfe is hereby appointed a member of the Isthmian Canal Commission at the rate of Fourteen Thousand Dollars ($14,000.00) per annum, effective this date.

identity_evidence: Text is Executive Order 1352, signed Taft May 11, 1911, prohibiting evasion of fare on Canal Zone railway trains; the claim is No. 1285 of January 16, 1911 on French dump cars
basis: The text is a different order (number 1352, May 11, 1911, railway fare evasion) and does not mention French dump cars, gravel or July 1; it cannot stand for the claimed order.
notes: The text itself would be a Canal Zone penal order, but it is not the claimed order.

identity_evidence: The White House, November 25, 1919; amends Section 3 of the 1914 order on conditions of employment for the permanent force of the Panama Canal, signed Wilson
basis: Amends pay and transportation terms for persons appointed in the United States to the Panama Canal permanent force; it governs only the canal's employees' conditions of service.
end_or_bound: no later than 1999-12-31 (U.S. operation of the canal ended)
operative_quote: The compensation and conditions of employment of persons employed in the United States will be specified in the appointments.

identity_evidence: Executive Order 1250, signed Taft October 4, 1910, abolishing the position of tax collector and amending Canal Zone tax law
basis: Abolishes the District Tax Collector office, creates deputy collectors and sets Zone tax lien and sale rules; all content is Canal Zone government revenue administration.
operative_quote: Section 1. The office of the District Tax Collector, created by paragraph 2 of the Executive Order effective April 15, 1907, is hereby abolished.
notes: Tax sale titles and deeds are accrued effects, not continuing effect of the order.

identity_evidence: Executive Order 732, signed Roosevelt January 9, 1908, applying Law No. 6 of Panama on exclusion of certain aliens to the Canal Zone
basis: Extends a Panamanian exclusion law to the Canal Zone and sets fines imposed by Zone courts; it applies only within the Zone, and is open-ended ('until further ordered') but only as to Zone law.
end_or_bound: no later than 1982-03-31 (Zone courts impose the fines; Zone government ended 1979-10-01)
operative_quote: That, until further ordered, Law No. 6, of March 11, 1904, of the Republic of Panama, as applied and construed by the Executive Decree of April 15, 1904, is hereby extended to and made applicable to the Canal Zone.
notes: Text does not use the word Chinese; claimed title refers to it, but the subject (aliens named in Law No. 6) agrees.

identity_evidence: Executive Order 1190, signed Taft April 16, 1910, defining duties of Counsel and Chief Attorney for the Isthmian Canal Commission and amending the Code of Criminal Procedure

end_or_bound: no later than 1982-03-31 (Zone courts and police)
